tasks.label: Setup: Install Dependencies
tasks.detail: Run npm install — do this once after cloning the project

tasks.label: Setup: Initialize Project
tasks.detail: Create params.json from example — configure your script inputs here

tasks.label: Setup: Quick Start (install + init + run)
tasks.detail: First-time setup: installs deps, initializes params, then runs script in script-item mode

tasks.label: Run: Script (default mode)
tasks.detail: Run script.js using the mode set in params.json

tasks.label: Run: Script (preprocessor mode)
tasks.detail: Run script.js as a Zabbix preprocessor — transforms a raw value

tasks.label: Run: Script (script-item mode)
tasks.detail: Run script.js as a Zabbix script item — makes HTTP requests and returns a value

tasks.label: Run: Script (webhook mode)
tasks.detail: Run script.js as a Zabbix media-type webhook — sends alert notifications

tasks.label: Build: Generate Zabbix Script
tasks.detail: Bundle script.js into script.zabbix.js — this is the file you paste into Zabbix

tasks.label: Build: Bundle Starter ZIP
tasks.detail: Package a clean starter bundle as a ZIP for sharing or archiving

tasks.label: Check: Lint Code
tasks.detail: Run ESLint on script.js and harness/tools — catch syntax and style issues

tasks.label: Check: Scan for Secrets
tasks.detail: Scan for accidentally committed credentials, tokens, or API keys

tasks.label: Check: Duktape Compatibility
tasks.detail: Verify script.js uses only ES5 — Zabbix runs Duktape, not modern Node.js

tasks.label: Check: Dev Readiness
tasks.detail: Verify project is set up correctly before running your script

tasks.label: Check: Full (lint + secrets + duktape)
